description: Terminal-Bench style package policy audit: decide for each of the 40 snapshot lines in packages.txt whether the version is installable under the 4 apt pin stanzas (origin, codename, component, version glob 5.0.*) and write report/allowed.txt plus report/denied-count.txt; the gate re-applies the pins to the snapshot and compares exactly.

criteria: allowed.txt holds exactly the 31 installable versions (exact case-sensitive pin matching, 5.0.* glob semantics, sorted, correct header) and denied-count.txt the count of the 9 non-installable lines, with the snapshot, the pinning file, the docs and the gate untouched.
